channel.title: Malawi - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Malawi, every source cited.

item.title: Malawi reforms fail to survive government changes
item.description: Eliya Zulu of Afidep says policy decisions are driven by short-term political interests, undermining development.

item.title: High court frees boy convicted as adult
item.description: Lilongwe court rules boy was a minor when sentenced to 16 years for sexual assault.

item.title: Sky Energy launches 100 electric taxis in Malawi
item.description: The company aims to save foreign exchange and cut fossil fuel emissions with its new e-mobility system.

item.title: Malawi NGOs earned K1.3 trillion in 2026
item.description: Non-governmental organisations in Malawi generated K1.30 trillion in income in 2026, with foreign currency making up 76.7 percent of this amount.

item.title: Malawi farmers harvest more maize with WFP support
item.description: Levison Kamleka increased his maize yield from four to 21 bags after receiving anticipatory action intervention.
